name: Strathcona 2019

venue.name: [Strathcona Community Center](http://www.strathcona.ca/departments/facility-services/community-centre/)
venue.address: 401 Festival Ln, Sherwood Park, AB T8A 5T8

information: Experienced and aspiring cubers alike! Join us for a variety of official events and even more fun events like the 3x3 Blind Mirror solve (Please bring your own mirror cube to participate)!  We'll have a few mystery events scattered throughout the day, so be prepared to have a lot of fun!  Come equipped and prepared to show off your prodigious high order cube solving skills over a lunchtime exhibition, and hear the audience ask "Oh when will it solve?!"
